raw_response: {"diagnosis":"raw_transactions holds 26 corrected re-deliveries (record_version=2) of txn_ids that were already delivered as version 1, so silver_transactions has duplicate txn_ids. The fix keeps only the latest version per txn_id (highest record_version, then latest ingest_ts) and applies the POSTED filter after that, so a txn whose latest version is REVERSED is dropped.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.85,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
